project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + Better Auth + Neon PostgreSQL + Flutter mobile app
build_system: npm scripts for Next.js, flutter build for mobile. No complex build pipeline.
test_framework: None configured yet. Manual testing via npm run dev and flutter run.
test_command: npm run dev (development server on localhost:3000)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run db:push to apply schema changes. 2. Run npm run dev to start dev server. 3. Test OAuth flow by clicking 'Sign in with Google' on /login. 4. Test device tracking by logging in from new browser (clear localStorage). 5. For mobile: cd mobile && flutter run on emulator.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Drizzle generates types but they are not committed. Build artifacts in .next/ are gitignored.
environment_constraints: Google OAuth requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET in .env.local. Mobile Google Sign-In requires SHA-1 fingerprint in Firebase Console. Better Auth session cookies are HTTP-only. Device tracking requires X-Device-ID and X-Device-Name headers from client.
contribution_requirements: Phase 1 doctor auth implementation left 3 items incomplete: Google OAuth callback route, device tracking integration into login flow, and Flutter mobile implementation. These must be completed without breaking existing doctor provisioning, first-login password reset, or check-in/checkout APIs.
key_patterns: Better Auth configured in lib/auth-config.ts with bearer plugin for mobile. API routes use getAuthenticatedUser() from Better Auth. Drizzle ORM queries use db.select().from(table).where(eq(...)). Email service in lib/email.ts uses nodemailer. Device tracking in lib/middleware/device-tracking.ts checks userDevices table. Flutter follows clean architecture: data/domain/presentation layers with Riverpod for state management.
directory_structure: app/ contains Next.js App Router pages and API routes. app/api/auth/ has authentication endpoints. app/api/doctor/ has doctor-specific APIs. app/doctor/ has doctor dashboard pages. lib/ has utilities and middleware. db/ has Drizzle schema. mobile/lib/ has Flutter app with features/ directory for feature modules. .agents/tasks/ has task documentation and artifacts.
